findings.label: Side effects inside setState updater
findings.detail: toggleApiLayers calls the setSelected*/setShowMagmaLegend setters from inside the setShowApiLayers updater, which React double-invokes in StrictMode. It is harmless today because the setters are idempotent. Read showApiLayers in the callback, or clear the popups in an effect keyed on it.
